subject: Security exhibit — evidence cadence, pen-test window & handoff
messages:
From: Julia Kramer <julia.kramer@veramed.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Security exhibit — evidence cadence and pen test questions

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the quick turnaround on the order form. Before we move the MSA to legal, VeraMed needs to confirm two items in the security exhibit:

1) SOC 2 evidence cadence — we typically request a rolling 12-month evidence window plus an annual attestation. Can Redwood support on-demand retrieval of SOC 2 artifacts (system descriptions, control narratives, user access logs) within a 10-business-day SLA?

2) Pen-test language & scope — we require the vendor to allow an annual third-party penetration test with read-only staging access for the tester and an agreed-upon notification window. We also need a clear timeline for evidence handoff after the test completes.

We'd like to schedule a short call to align the scope and what evidence looks like (sample logs, retention periods). Are you available Thursday afternoon (PDT)?

Thanks,
Julia Kramer
Director, Procurement — VeraMed Health
procurement@veramed.com


From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Julia Kramer <julia.kramer@veramed.com>
Cc: priyom.das@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security exhibit — evidence cadence and pen test questions

Julia —

Appreciate the clarity. Quick answers up front:
- SOC 2 evidence: yes, we can produce a 12-month rolling window and provide on-demand artifact access; standard turnaround is 7–10 business days for packaged evidence.
- Pen test: we support an annual third-party test; we require a staging-only, read-only scope for vendor-managed environments and a 30-day pre-test notification (for scheduling and token rotation). Evidence (full report + logs) typically delivered within 10 business days post-test.

I'll loop in Legal (Priyom) for any redline language they want to propose and Security (Karthik) to capture the technical constraints and the pen-test matrix.

Can we do Thu 5/20 2:00–2:30pm PDT? If that works I'll send a calendar invite and a short agenda.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Lead, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: priyom.das@redwood.ai <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 11:10:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Security exhibit — evidence cadence and pen test questions

Marissa / team —

I reviewed Julia's ask and sketched a proposed redline snippet for the MSA Security Exhibit we can push in advance of the call. Key points:

- SOC 2: Vendor will provide access to SOC 2 Type II attestation and supporting artifacts for the prior 12 months within ten (10) business days of a written request, subject to any confidentiality restrictions of third-party auditors.

- Penetration Testing: Vendor permits one (1) annual third-party penetration test against non-production environments; Vendor must receive written notice at least thirty (30) days prior to testing. External testers shall be approved by Vendor and adhere to Vendor's test rules of engagement. Vendor will provide remediation status and a redacted executive summary within ten (10) business days of test completion; full unredacted reports and logs will be provided under a separate NDA and secure upload mechanism within fifteen (15) business days.

Notes / questions for the call:
- Can VeraMed accept an approval step for testers to avoid privileged escalation risk?
- We'll propose the secure upload link (S3 presigned or secure portal) for evidence delivery.

Attaching a light-weight pen_test_scope_matrix.csv I pulled together that maps the staging endpoints we can expose and the types of tests we allow. Karthik — please validate the exposure matrix and retention periods before the call.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.ai

Attachments: pen_test_scope_matrix.csv (attachment)

From: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: priyom.das@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Julia Kramer <julia.kramer@veramed.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Security exhibit — evidence cadence and pen test questions

Folks / Julia —

Quick technical confirmations on what we can support and what we prefer:

- Staging access: we can provide isolated staging environments with data masked and readonly accounts for testers. We do not permit run-of-network scanning against production or any lateral movement tests.

- Notification window: 30 days is acceptable. We also ask for a short pre-scan questionnaire with target IP ranges and tests planned.

- Evidence handoff: operational logs (auth, API audit trail) are retained for 13 months; we can export relevant slices and deliver via secure portal. Raw kernel-level logs are not included in standard exports; those require an escalation and may be subject to legal review.

I revised the pen_test_scope_matrix.csv with the permitted test types and the staging endpoints. See notes inline.

K
Karthik Iyer
Head of Security Eng — Inference Runtime
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai

We look forward to aligning on the formal redlines and the pen-test schedule.

Best,
Julia
